name: TankBatteryInventoryMonitor
tagline: See every tank's level, know when it reaches high level, and get the haul there first.
description: A complete tank-battery inventory app for oil and gas production in one Power Apps code component: tank levels against capacity and the high-level alarm for oil, produced water and condensate, an overfill forecast, haul suggestions, a haul / sales-run board with SLA, run tickets with a BS&W sales check, and a daily battery balance (opening + production − runs vs gauged). Works with demo data the moment it is dropped on a canvas screen, model-driven form or Power Pages page.
features: Level, room to high level and hours to high level per tank
Overfill risk (critical / warning hours) and +12/24/48 h forecast
Top gauge in feet and inches converted with capacity and shell height
Haul suggestions and Request all suggested
Haul requested → Scheduled → Running → Active with SLA
Scheduling after the high-level time blocked
Unique run tickets, run volume within inventory
Daily battery balance with tolerance and critical %
Out of service with reason, only when production is diverted
Bulk actions, undo, CSV export, paging
